definition: a metal rod for stirring a fire
description: In an elegant sitting room at night with a big stone fireplace, a young man in a black dinner suit crouches on the stone floor and pushes a long metal poker into the fire. A huge burst of flame and orange sparks shoots up. He stands up and walks away from the fireplace, holding the poker with its tip still burning. Behind him guests in evening dresses and dinner jackets sit on sofas and watch. Logs, a hearth brush, tongs and a coal bucket lie on the floor.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er schürt das Feuer mit einem Schürhaken.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está atizando el fuego con un atizador.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il attise le feu avec un tisonnier.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
